org.label: Organization

ask.disabled: Ask is available after your first upload.

settings.title: Settings

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Append-only record of actions in this organization.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.intro: Every component and state on demo data. Internal reference, not a product screen.
gallery.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
gallery.timelineConflict: Conflicting event; the carrier feed overrides the manual entry.
gallery.chartVarianceDesc: Unit price against the item's observed range.
gallery.chartConcentrationDesc: Pareto: spend per supplier with cumulative share.
gallery.chartEtaDesc: 80% band with the median and the promised date.
gallery.askReadOnly: Read-only. Every number cites its Evidence.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.error: Wrong email or password. Check them and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute.
upload.title: Upload purchase history
upload.intro: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV export from 1C, SAP or any accounting system. Nothing is stored until you confirm the columns.
upload.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB. Split it by period and upload the parts.
upload.mappingHint: We suggested a column for each field. Change any that are wrong. Required: item, price (or total and quantity), date.
upload.duplicate: This file was already uploaded. Nothing was imported twice.
review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Lines we could not match with enough confidence. Choose the right item; each decision also improves the matcher's test set.
review.sampleHint: Codes are synthetic until real ЕНС ТРУ data is connected.
review.emptyHint: New uploads with uncertain lines will appear here.
review.keys: Keys: J/K move, A accept, R no match, 1–5 choose, U undo
review.bundledHint: Excluded from price comparison until split.
review.noCandidates: No similar items in the classifier.
findings.title: Findings
findings.noneHint: Run the analysis after matching. Only lines with a confirmed item and price take part.
findings.draft: Draft: the client sees it only after review and release.
findings.staffOnly: Only reviewers can run the analysis.
findings.error: The analysis stopped because two independent calculations disagreed. Nothing was saved.
ingest.error.too_large: The file is larger than 25 MB. Split it by period.
ingest.error.unsupported_type: Use .xlsx or .csv. Old .xls and macro files (.xlsm) are not accepted.
ingest.error.unreadable: The file cannot be read. It may be damaged or password-protected. Save it again without a password.
ingest.error.macros: The workbook contains macros. Save it as a normal .xlsx file without macros.
ingest.error.encoding: The text encoding is not recognised. Save the CSV as UTF-8.
ingest.error.too_many_rows: More than 200,000 rows. Split the file by period.
ingest.error.bad_mapping: Choose columns for item, price and date.
ingest.error.forbidden: Your role cannot upload purchase data in this organization.
ingest.row.missing_item: Row {row}: the item name is empty. Fill it in or skip the row.
ingest.row.missing_date: Row {row}: the date is missing. Fix the file or skip the row.
ingest.row.bad_date: Row {row}: the date is not valid (expected 14.03.2026). Fix the file or skip the row.
ingest.row.bad_number: Row {row}: a number cannot be read. Check the price and quantity.
ingest.row.missing_price: Row {row}: no price and no total with quantity.
ingest.row.unknown_currency: Row {row}: the currency is not recognised (use KZT, USD, RUB, EUR or CNY).
gate.approveBlocked: Decide the remaining {count} findings before approving.
gate.releaseConfirm: Confirm release: this cannot be undone
gate.noteRequired: Add a note to explain this decision.
gate.noteVisible: Notes on kept findings are visible to the client. Notes on rejected findings are not.
gate.closed: This report is closed. Changes need a new version.
gate.keys: Keys: J / K move, A keep, E keep with note, R reject, Esc cancel.
gate.title: Review
gate.error.transition_not_allowed: This step is not allowed in the report's current state.
gate.error.report_not_in_review: Decisions can only be made while the report is in review.
gate.error.undecided_findings: Some findings have no decision yet.
gate.error.note_required: Add a note to explain this decision.
gate.error.approval_review_required: The approval was not recorded. Try again.
gate.error.rejection_review_required: The rejection was not recorded. Try again.
gate.error.four_eyes_runner_cannot_appro: Two-person rule: the person who ran the analysis cannot approve it.
gate.error.four_eyes_approver_cannot_rel: Two-person rule: the approver cannot also release.
gate.error.report_frozen: This report can no longer be changed.
gate.error.findings_frozen: Findings cannot change once the report is in review.
gate.error.finding_not_in_report: This finding belongs to another report.
gate.error.staff_only: Only a reviewer can do this.
report.headline: Potential savings
report.headlineHint: {count} findings, each checked by a person.
report.headlineEvidence: Sum of the findings the reviewer kept
report.byTypeDescription: Bars show the saving per type; the line shows the running share of the total.
report.byTypeTable: Savings by finding type, as a table
report.todo.outlier: Check unusual orders with the buyers
report.todo.repeat_purchase: Combine repeat orders into framework agreements
report.action.price_variance: Renegotiate the price of {item} with {supplier}, or move volume to cheaper suppliers.
report.action.outlier: Check this {item} order with the buyer: the price is far above its usual range.
report.action.repeat_purchase: Combine repeat orders of {item} into one framework agreement.
report.action.split_purchase: Review approval thresholds: purchases of {item} were split into smaller orders.
report.action.concentration: Qualify a second supplier for {item} to reduce dependence on {supplier}.
report.notReleased: Draft, not released to the client
report.pdf.howToCheck: Every figure has an Evidence id. Open the report in QazSupply and search for the id to see the source rows and the computation.
ask.title: Ask about this report
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: where did we overpay the most?
ask.reading: Reading the report and checking every figure…
ask.aiLabel: AI-written answer. Every figure is checked against your report before it is shown.
ask.cannot: I can't answer that from your data
ask.cannotHint: Ask about the findings in this report: where you overpaid, which suppliers, what to do next.
ask.suggestion1: Where did we overpay the most?
ask.suggestion2: Which supplier should we renegotiate with first?
ask.suggestion3: What is the total potential saving?
ask.dropped: Some sentences were removed because their figures could not be checked.
ask.error.ask_disabled: Ask is off for your organization. An administrator can turn it on in Settings.
ask.error.ask_unavailable: Ask is not available right now.
ask.error.blocked_budget: Your organization's monthly AI budget is used up.
ask.error.blocked_kill_switch: AI features are paused by QazSupply. Your reports are not affected.
ask.error.model_error: The AI service did not respond. Try again in a minute.
ask.error.not_released: Ask works on released reports only.
settings.ask: Allow Ask (AI answers about released reports)
settings.askHint: When on, the findings of released reports (item, supplier, amounts) are sent to an AI model provider to answer questions. Uploaded files and purchase rows are never sent.
settings.fourEyesHint: The person who ran an analysis cannot approve it, and the approver cannot release it. Set by QazSupply.
settings.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change this.
